newsitem.title: GERMANY: MG unit enters joint venture in China.
newsitem.headline: MG unit enters joint venture in China.

text.p: German chemical group Sachtleben Chemie GmbH, a unit of Metallgesellschaft AG (MG) has founded a joint venture in China to produce the colouring pigment Lithopone, Metallgesellschaft said on Monday.
The joint-venture will begin operating a plant with 50,000 tonnes annual production capacity, located in Guangzhou, China, in early 1997.
This will allow the joint-venture to become the world's largest manufacturer of the colouring pigment, Metallgesellschaft said.

Metallgesellschaft added that Sachtleben, which will have a 40 percent stake in the joint venture, will provide the know-how to the joint venture and will be responsible for marketing outside of China.

Metallgesellschaft added that a gradual movement of Lithopone production to China was part of the group's international strategy. Freed-up capacities in Germany would be used to manufacture other products, Metallgesellschaft said.
